core_obligations: Spell out the precise statement: the outer exchange map must equal the composite of the two square exchange maps with the derived pushforwards of the composites written as compositions (proof lines 2851-2861).

Represent the maps: choose K-injective representatives so that both square exchange maps are given by quasi-isomorphisms a and b of complexes, each shown to be a quasi-isomorphism by the proof of the exchange lemma (proof lines 2862-2883).
Conclude: K-injectivity of the pushed-forward complexes makes Rg_*(a) = g_*(a), and the composition g_*(a) after b is the exchange arrow of the outer rectangle (proof lines 2879-2889).
